blocks.content: Course: API Handling with Asynchronous Javascript
Now that we understand each component, here is the complete application. Every function we examined works together as a single system.

items: The user is prompted for a search term.
If valid, fetchJobs() contacts the API.
If successful, displayJobs() shows the results.
Any errors along the way are caught and displayed.

blocks.content: Each function has a single job. Each edge case has a handler. The code is readable, maintainable, and robust.
This is how professional applications are built!
Now, how about trying your hand at building something similar?
